name: Open SaaS Directory

sources.title: Homepage — 'Free, self-hosted alternatives to the SaaS you already pay for'; 105+ curated open-source projects
Submit a Project page — 'Submit your open-source SaaS project to the directory' (client-rendered form)
Companion GitHub repo — awesome list synced from the directory database

requirements: Open-source, self-hostable SaaS only — every listing is a 'free, self-hosted alternative to the SaaS you already pay for'
Entries show GitHub stats (stars, contributors, license, last-commit) — a public GitHub repo is effectively required
Closed-source SaaS products do not fit this directory
Sponsorship slots exist separately ('Become a sponsor')
preparation: Public GitHub repository URL (stars/license data is pulled automatically)
Project name, description, and which paid SaaS product(s) it replaces
Category pick (web analytics, CRM, billing, project management, etc.)
Contact email (a you@email.com field is present on the form)
workflow: Fill the submission form — the page previews the directory listing live as you type
Submit for review; the directory is 'curated and updated regularly'
watchFor: Strict scope: open-source + self-hostable only — a proprietary SaaS submission will not fit
The submit form is client-rendered — needs JS; field list could not be fully verified statically
Listings are synced into a public GitHub awesome-list — your repo stats are republished there
Small directory (105+ projects) run by a solo builder (Mohsen)
countsAsLive: The project gets a /projects/<slug> page with GitHub stats and appears in category/alternatives listings
unknowns: Exact form fields and whether review is manual or automated
